request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. A real photograph of a whiteboard for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. The board shows only numbers and, where the instruction says so, one small drawing: no month names, no day names, no letters and no words anywhere, in any language. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames added, no padding, watermark or captions.

This is a precise edit of image 1: the result must look like the same photograph with one mark added. Change only what the instruction names.

Image 1 is a photograph of a whiteboard year planner with twelve numbered boxes. Keep the photograph exactly as it is: the same framing, the same board and wooden frame, the year at the top, every box number from 1 to 12 in the same place and every small grid of day squares. Do not move, redraw, add or remove any number. Add only this: inside box 12 (the fourth box of the bottom row), one small, simple, colorful hand-drawn BIRTHDAY CAKE in marker (a pink cake with three lit candles), about a third of the box high, placed in the empty right part of the box so that it does not cover the number 12; and ONE freehand dark-blue pen loop around the whole of box 12, enclosing its number and the cake. No other box has a drawing or a loop. No letters or words anywhere.
